2026-11-07.body: The whole image angle is what pulls me in here. The frame is a decision about what does not get to be in it, and posts like this are where that actually shows. What did you leave out of the frame?

The whole mountain angle is what pulls me in here. The same path twice a week teaches more than a new trail every time, and posts like this are where that actually shows. Have the seasons shifted this in recent years?

There is a specific kind of attention in writing about the mountain part the way you did. A single tree changes the temperature and the mood of a whole street, and most people skip straight past it. What else grows or visits here?

Tue Oct 20.body: You went straight at the the completely part, so here is the rest of that thought. Recipes travel like dialects. Same dish, different household, different rules, and that is the piece I would add to your point. What did this replace in your kitchen?
